header.name: [bedrock-research]inventory-ui-basic-components-bp_v1.0.0
header.description: v1.0.0 - 25 basic Ore UI style components drawn in an entity chest screen, one page each. Every press goes to the server as a slot button and the server answers through slot names. Works next to the other entity inventory examples. Use the Inventory UI Basic Components item from the creative inventory.
